bot.description: Hi! I am a demo bot that shows what Telegram bots written in Python can do: keyboards, forms, media, inline mode, reminders, payments and more. Press Start!
bot.short_description: Telegram Bot API showcase in Python: keyboards, forms, media, inline mode, reminders, Stars.
cmd.photo: Random photo with an edit button
cmd.dice: Roll a die / throw a dart
start.welcome: 👋 Hi, {name}! I am a demo bot that shows what a Telegram bot written in Python can do. Use the keyboard below or the menu button next to the input field.
start.referral_ok: 🤝 You joined using a friend's invite link. Thanks!
menu.title: 🏠 Main menu Pick a demo:
menu.placeholder: Choose an action or type a command
help.title: ℹ️ What I can do
help.footer: 💡 Send me a photo, document, voice message, sticker, location or contact — I will tell you what I see. In any chat type @botname text to use inline mode.
invite.share_text: Check out this Telegram bot demo!
settings.title: ⚙️ Settings Interface language: {language}
catalog.title: 🛍 Catalog — page {page} of {pages} ({total} items) Pick an item:
feedback.ask_name: 📝 Feedback (step 1/4) What is your name? Send /cancel at any time to stop.
feedback.ask_email:
📧 Step 2/4: your e-mail?
Send /skip if you prefer not to share it.
feedback.ask_rating: ⭐ Step 3/4: how do you rate this bot?
feedback.ask_message: 💬 Step 4/4: write your message (at least 10 characters).
feedback.thanks: 🙏 Thank you! Your feedback #{id} has been saved.
feedback.timeout: ⌛ The form was closed because of inactivity.
feedback.private_only: 📝 The feedback form works in a private chat with the bot only.
feedback.err_name_length: The name must be {min}–{max} characters long.
feedback.err_name_chars: The name may only contain letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes.
feedback.err_email: This does not look like a valid e-mail. Try again or send /skip.
feedback.err_rating: Please choose a rating from 1 to 5 using the buttons.
feedback.err_message_short: The message is too short: at least {min} characters, please.
feedback.err_message_long: The message is too long: at most {max} characters, please.
media.photo_caption: 📸 A random photo. Press the button to replace it in place (editMessageMedia).
media.album_caption: 🗂 Three photos sent as one album (sendMediaGroup).
media.document_caption: 📄 Your profile as a JSON file, generated in memory.
poll.question: Which Python library do you use for Telegram bots?
incoming.photo: 🖼 Nice photo! Largest size: {width}×{height}, {size} (Telegram stores {count} sizes). Sent back by file_id without re-uploading.
incoming.location: 📍 You are at {lat}, {lon}. That is {distance} km from the Eiffel Tower.
incoming.contact_own: 📱 Thanks, {name}! This is your own contact. (The phone number is not stored.)
incoming.contact_other: 📱 Contact of {name} received. (The phone number is not stored.)
effects.liftoff: 🚀 Liftoff! This message was edited three times.
effects.typed: ⌨️ Did you see "typing…" at the top of the chat? That is sendChatAction.
effects.self_destruct: 💣 This message (and your command) will be deleted in {seconds} s.
reminders.empty: You have no pending reminders. Create one: /remind 10m drink water
reminders.err_invalid: Usage: /remind <time> <text> Examples: /remind 10m tea, /remind 1h 30m call mom, /remind 2d pay rent
reminders.err_too_short: The delay must be greater than zero.
reminders.err_no_text: What should I remind you about? Example: /remind 10m tea
reminders.err_text_too_long: The reminder text is too long (max 500 characters).
reminders.err_too_many: You already have {limit} pending reminders. Delete some with /reminders.
